title: Half Back Rebound Run And Carry (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, when the ball comes to the back half
You start the whole chain from here
Dont boot it long and hope, use your brain

[Verse 1]
Receive the handball, head up, read the space
Look for the corridor up the center of the place
Short kick to the lead or carry it yourself
Dont bomb it long and put it on the shelf

Fifty metre rebound starts in the back pockets
Out to the wing, the chain has rockets
Half back half back, read the defensive press
Use both boots, use both hands, no mess

[Pre-Chorus]
Look up look up, see the lead
Short and sharp is all you need
Carry to fifty or switch the play
Half back rebound makes the day

[Chorus]
Half back rebound, ignite the chain
From the back line out the center plain
Short and accurate, carry when clear
Half back rebound brings the goal near

[Verse 2]
Left foot or right foot, both boots must go
A rebound half with one boot is too slow
Two months of left foot drills in the yard
Chas has the cone set, training is hard

[Bridge]
Bluey: He has come off half back at pace, beautiful skills on display
Trevor: His left foot development over the season has been remarkable
Chas: Forty-five minutes a day. Every morning. Rain or shine.

[Chorus]
Half back rebound, ignite the chain
From the back line out the center plain
Short and accurate, carry when clear
Half back rebound brings the goal near

[Outro]
Both boots son. Both boots.
Thats my boy
